You **cannot** buy shares of **McKinsey & Company**.[[1]](https://salesmotion.io/company-intelligence/mckinsey)

- **Private Partnership:** McKinsey is a privately held partnership owned by its senior partners rather than a publicly traded corporation.
- **No Public Stock:** The firm has never had an IPO and does not trade on any stock exchange.
- **Alternative Investments:** Because you cannot buy McKinsey directly, investors interested in the consulting or professional services sector typically look at publicly traded competitors or advisory firms (such as Accenture, Gartner, or FTI Consulting).[[1]](https://salesmotion.io/company-intelligence/mckinsey)
